related.title: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy：選擇器聯集與雙向允許
related.titleEn: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy: selector unions and two-sided permission
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付9動作來源圖、4動作需求表、拒絕回歸與綁定替換紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the nine-action provenance map, four-action requirements, denial regression and binding replacement record.
related.difference: 對隔離中的來源與目的同時檢查egress及ingress，分清同一規則內的交集與多規則聯集。
related.differenceEn: For isolated source and destination, check both egress and ingress; distinguish conjunctions within a rule from unions across rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 有效權限是所有適用允許集合的聯集；移除一個綁定不代表該權限必定消失。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 Role A允許6個不同動作，Role B允許5個，兩者重疊2個；控制器實際只需4個，且這4個全部包含在原始與變更後的允許聯集中。 聯集6+5−2=9個，額外權限9−4=5個。
在本案例兩端均隔離時，可通=來源egress允許且目的ingress允許；政策支援依賴網路實作。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個候選有向連線中egress允許8個、ingress允許7個，兩者同時允許5個。 政策允許5/12=41.6667%，不是8+7條；只有在其他網路條件正常且政策實際生效時才可推論可通。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Effective permissions are the union of applicable allows; removing one binding does not guarantee revocation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Role A permits six distinct actions and B five, with two overlapping; the controller needs four actions, all contained in both the original and changed permission unions. The union contains 6+5−2=9 actions, five beyond the four required.

With both endpoints isolated, connectivity requires source egress AND destination ingress permission; enforcement depends on network implementation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twelve directed candidate connections, egress allows eight and ingress seven; five are allowed by both. Policy permits 5/12=41.6667%, not eight plus seven connections; actual connectivity additionally assumes a working network and enforced policy.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
